test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 30 Sept, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: How many cities have been selected to be developed as sustainable and responsible destinations as per the Swadesh Darshan 2.0 scheme launched by the Union Ministry of Tourism in January 2023?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**30**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Swadesh Darshan 2.0** scheme was launched by the **Union Ministry of Tourism** in **January 2023**.
 
• The scheme focuses on developing **sustainable and responsible tourism destinations** in India.
 
• A total of **30 cities** have been selected under this scheme to be developed as **sustainable and responsible destinations**.
 
• The revamped scheme aims to promote **theme-based tourism circuits** while ensuring environmental and cultural sustainability.
 
• The initiative aligns with the global focus on **sustainable tourism practices** and supports the **United Nations Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs)**.
 
• The scheme emphasizes the use of **green technologies**, community participation, and preserving **local heritage and culture**.
 
• It also promotes **employment generation** and enhances the overall tourism experience by providing modern infrastructure and facilities.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Swadesh Darshan Scheme**

 
 
• The original **Swadesh Darshan Scheme** was launched in **2014-15** with the aim of developing theme-based tourism circuits across India.
 
• It has been revamped as **Swadesh Darshan 2.0** to focus on **sustainability and responsibility**.
 
• Under the initial version of the scheme, **15 thematic circuits** were identified, such as **Buddhist Circuit**, **Himalayan Circuit**, and **Coastal Circuit**.
 
 
 
• **United Nations Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs)**
 
 
• The scheme supports **SDG Goal 8** (Decent Work and Economic Growth) and **SDG Goal 12** (Responsible Consumption and Production).
 
• It also aligns with **SDG Goal 15** (Life on Land) by promoting environmental conservation in tourism activities.
